newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DeVry price targets raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DeVry price targets raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securiites Inc said Monday it raised its stock price targets for DeVry Inc, the provider of higher education and degrees in technical and business areas, to $48 from $42 for the period six months from now, and to $57 from $50 for 18 months out.

--DeVry is well positioned to benefit from higher enrollment rates driven by increasing numbers of high school graduates, higher college participation rates, a curriculum focused on fast growing technology-oriented and business management career education and an enlarging network of campus locations, EVEREN noted in a report.
